title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the electric field strength as E_0 = m v_0^2 / (q r_0).

title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the magnetic induction as B = m v_0 / (q r_0).

title: Light ion exit velocity
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem to find the velocity of the 0.5m ion after the electrostatic analyzer, obtaining v = sqrt(5) v_0.

title: Light ion magnetic radius
description: Important: Uses magnetic force law to find the radius of the 0.5m ion's path in the magnetic field, obtaining r = (sqrt(5)/2) r_0.

title: Impact distance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance from O to the impact point of the 0.5m ion as 1.5 r_0, using geometry and the given cos θ.

title: Resolution condition setup
description: Important: Sets up the geometric condition for the beams to be just resolved, relating the shifted impact positions to the magnetic field fluctuation ΔB.

title: Final fluctuation ratio
description: Essential: Solves (or approximates) the resolution condition to find the maximum required ΔB/B, yielding approximately 0.12.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in force directions or misplaces units in final expressions.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies the geometric relationships (e.g., for the impact point l) or misuses the given cos θ.

title: Work-energy misapplication
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies the work-energy theorem for the 0.5m ion, such as using the wrong potential difference or mass.
